description: Interviews, village walkthroughs, and hardware spotlights produced by the DEF CON Video Team at DEF CON 31.

talks.title: Red Team Village Overview and Operations
talks.teaser: An overview of the Red Team Village at DEF CON 31 highlighting adversary emulation workshops, attack demonstrations, and offensive tradecraft.

talks.title: Recon Village Walkthrough and Open-Source Intelligence
talks.teaser: A walkthrough of Recon Village at DEF CON 31 exploring open-source intelligence methodologies, attack surface discovery, and recon CTF challenges.

talks.title: Car Hacking Village: CAN Bus and Vehicle Research
talks.teaser: A tour of the Car Hacking Village at DEF CON 31 featuring vehicle test benches, instrument cluster analysis, and automotive security research.

talks.title: Hack The Box Community Showcase
talks.teaser: A showcase of Hack The Box community activities, training labs, and interactive cybersecurity challenges hosted at DEF CON 31.

talks.title: Apple TV Spoof and Hallway Shenanigans

talks.title: Red Team Village Interview and CTF Update

talks.title: HackerBoxes Interview with Silk
